t: You're at St. John's Wood tube station, in the City of Westminster. It opened in 1939 as a stop on the Bakerloo line. Today it's on the Jubilee line, between Swiss Cottage and Baker Street, in fare zone 2. The architect was Stanley Heaps, who lived from 1880 to 1962. He designed a number of stations on the Underground, and also train depots and bus and trolleybus garages for London Transport. This station is one of those many commissions.
